The '''''Supreme''-Class Servant Droid''' was an elegant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Lovolan]] to cater to high society in places like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The ''Supreme''-Class is able to speak multiple [[Language/Legends|languages]] and dialects, has an extensive knowledge of upper-class interests and activities, and a communication system that keeps it in contact with news and financial databases. One ''Servant''-Class droid, [[Threna]], ended up misplaced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grathus]], and ended up serving drinks at [[Xig Rollem]]'s tavern.
